text:
Oliver (CS): Heads up — Compass Labs needs final seat confirmation for the preview. They asked for 12 seats but only 8 are currently provisioned.
Maria C: Ack. Do we have an onboarding date locked? I thought it was next Tue.
Oliver (CS): They penciled Tue 2026-04-14 AM, but integration devs asked for extra lead time.
Devon S: Who's owning the infra pull? I can spin extra seats but need the details — region, private vs hosted.
Amanda - CS Ops: I have Compass point of contact: @jason_pm — Jason, can you confirm whether they want Hosted API or Dedicated for the preview? Also any data residency constraints?
Jason PM: They want Hosted to minimize ops burden for the trial, but will switch to Dedicated if SLA looks good. No special residency requests.
Oliver (CS): Ok, hosted then. Amanda, can you add 4 more seats to reach 12? We should mark as a risk on the renewal path until they onboard.
Amanda - CS Ops: I'll add seats short-term. Sending update to billing after provisioning. Also scheduling a 45m enablement session — propose Wed 10:00 PT. :calendar:
Maria C: Wed 10 PT works. Can we include a short checklist for the integration steps so their devs aren't blocked?
Devon S: I'll paste a minimal checklist here:
``
1) Install SDK 1.3.2
2) Set REDWOOD_API_KEY in env
3) Test completions endpoint with small prompt (<=512 tokens)
4) Enable KV caching optional
```
Jason PM: Perfect. Can we also capture a few feedback prompts to eval quality? Compass wants to measure hallucination on their dataset.
Oliver (CS): Let's send them our lightweight feedback form + a baseline prompt set. Amanda, can you send and collect responses in the next 10 days?
Amanda - CS Ops: Yep — I'll CC the customer and share a Google form. Will also create a thread in support for any integration bugs.
rotations-bot: Reminder: Beta participant Compass Labs onboarding due in 3 days. :bell:
Maria C: One more thing — renewal signal: customer indicated they want usage metrics in-app. Can Product hook a dashboard snippet we can show them during demo?
Jason PM: I'll prepare a snippet and an export of latency/cost per 1k tokens.
Oliver (CS): Great. I'll follow up after Wed enablement and tag any blockers. Thanks team :thumbsup:
